brief: Wave-0 registry: assign a node the next id and link it at the head.
decl: std::uint32_t registry_register(std::span<std::byte,0x58> node, std::uint32_t counter, std::uint32_t head);
notes: Body: node[0x20]=counter, counter increments at 0x886b9c, node[0x54]=head,
and the head global at 0x8e3b30 becomes the node. The host form takes the
counter and head explicitly and returns the new counter; the caller then
records the node as the new head, since the node address is an emulated
